question: GQ-001
subject: the want-list was fetching photographs of houses
the_symptom: a batch of 200 returned 123 OK and 77 NO_TEXT — and unlike the previous batch, ZERO were correspondence
what_they_are: property photographs and court filings — "3733 Chevy Chase Drive, La Canada Flintridge, California (front view)". The Architecture subject pulled in a photographic survey.
false_positive_check: of 365 matches across the entire list, ZERO are books — every one belongs to the same survey. The pattern is anchored at the start and needs a leading house number AND a street-type word, so "Roads and Bridges of Devon" cannot match.
the_structural_fix: a single isNotABook predicate combining correspondence and street-address, imported by BOTH the want-list builder and the index builder. The correspondence rule had to be added to the index builder separately, one turn after the want-list builder, because there was no combined predicate — this prevents the repeat.
